work_items: Agent Run Projection: Define a bounded `AgentRunProjection`-equivalent record binding exact Project ID, Engineering Run ID, Work Specification ID/revision/digest, stable acceptance IDs, current run revision/stage, accepted source lineage where present and a projection fingerprint/digest.
validations: Validation: Expose protected BUILD/TEST/VERIFY and deterministic browser/visual result through a bounded validation layer, ensuring deterministic failure remains explicit and cannot be hidden or overridden by qualitative evaluation/routing/competition output.
AC-01: validate protected requirement — Projection binds server-owned Project/run/spec/acceptance/source identity and rejects cross-context substitution.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — Team/task nodes derive only from accepted persisted/runtime evidence; client input cannot create or change task/agent authority.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Recovery/reassignment projection reflects durable worker generation/checkpoint state and cannot be synthesized from transient UI/model text.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — Protected deterministic failure remains explicit and cannot be hidden or overridden by qualitative evaluation/routing/competition output.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — Time/cost/usage/intervention evidence preserves observed/estimated/unknown state and provenance; unknown is never converted to zero.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Published PR/Preview evidence binds the exact accepted source/candidate/run identity and does not imply production authority.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — Only controls backed by an accepted server authority contract and valid current run state are advertised.
AC-08: validate protected requirement — Typed control requests bind expected identity/revision/state and fail closed on stale, unauthorized, cross-Project or unsupported requests.
AC-09: validate protected requirement — Projection reconstruction and exact control replay cannot duplicate canonical mutation, worker ownership change or provider publication.
AC-10: validate protected requirement — No secrets, credentials, raw provider payloads, prompts, hidden reasoning, source bytes/patches or unrestricted logs are exposed.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Projection/control code has no direct source acceptance, new lifecycle transition, provider administration, arbitrary command, merge/deploy or REVIEW completion authority.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — S2 semantic implementation cannot begin until Control Tower accepts W7-S1. Before integration, S2 reconciles to the latest accepted Wave 7 integration head, commits authentic DSPy evidence for `P2-V0.20.2`, passes protected spec validation and applicable exact-head gates, then stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION`.
risks: Risk: Unsupported controls are omitted or denied rather than invented for UI convenience, existing Engineering Run/worker/source/tool/provider state machines remain authoritative and unchanged, replay/reconnect of the same exact run produces equivalent projection identity, and existing Engineering Run/worker/source/tool/provider state machines remain authoritative and unchanged.

critique: One material implementation risk or omission in the approved software specification is the lack of a bounded `AgentRunProjection`-equivalent record binding for the existing Wave 6 agentic runtime, which can lead to incorrect or incomplete projection of server-owned Project, Work Specification, Engineering Run, worker checkpoint/recovery, source-lineage, validation, independent evaluation, routing/competition, provider delivery and run-event facts.
